d: Responsible for achievement of set growth, distribution and visibility targets in line with the brand objectives in the assigned Territory/ customers for the HoReCa channel.
Responsible for the delivery of the Sales, distribution objectives in line with the division and brand objectives.
Effective execution of channel and customer plans as per objectives.
Conduct business reviews with the designated HoReCa accounts on a periodic basis and enhance relationship with key decision makers.
Responsible to ensure timely submission of monthly statements to the assigned customers and cheque collections as per the due dates.
Ensure effective monthly sales forecasting and stock management.
Responsible for maintaining Factbook containing Sales Vs Targets, MSL List, Customer and Trade Information etc
Monitor and coordinate the day to day priorities in order to maintain the highest level of customer satisfaction.
2-5 years of experience in FMCG HoReCa sales in Bahrain in a similar role
Graduate degree from an accredited university preferred
Knowledge of the HoReCa distribution business
